text:
jordan: Heads-up — after the package.json exports change landed on main, a couple of sample apps (Next edge + Vite) fail to resolve types and end up pulling CJS into edge runtimes. Repro & notes below.

mina: saw reports this morning. which PR was that? iirc it added per-subpath `types` entries in `exports`.

alex: correct — PR #1423 added an exports map like:
```json
"exports": {
  "./*": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/*.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/*.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/*.d.ts"
  }
}
```
TS/Node/packagers behave differently: types under subpath aren't honoured by TS yet, bundlers resolve to `import`/`require` condition precedence, and some edge runtimes (Next edge / Cloudflare) fall back to the `require` path during build, so runtime hits `SyntaxError`.

tyler: repro steps I used:
1) `pnpm build && npm pack` in SDK
2) `npm i ../redwood-sdk-1.2.0.tgz` inside a clean next-edge sample
3) `pnpm build` -> build succeeds but runtime error on edge: 
```
SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module
    at wrapSafe (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```
(everything points to CJS being used where ESM expected)

sam: quick mitigation: revert the per-subpath `types` and instead set top-level `types`: "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" + `typesVersions` for path mappings. That avoids breaking TS resolution while we figure conditional types story. Also remove the erroneous `types` under the `exports` conditions.

liz: another manifestation: Vite dev server warned about dual resolution and ended up bundling the wrong entry for cloud builds. Workaround in Next was to add `experimental: { esmExternals: 'loose' }` but that causes other surprises. Not acceptable long-term.

build-bot: deploy failed: canary sample-app-next-edge (sdk@1.2.0) -> build job 6421 exited 1.

mina: I'm going to open a revert PR now (quick rollback of the exports change). we should also: 1) add CI smoke for next-edge + cloudflare sample 2) add a small TS resolution test that runs `tsc --traceResolution` against our packed tgz 3) add a changelog entry.

jordan: agreed. add a checklist in the PR description and tag `@devex` and `@eng-runtime`. also ping support to flag any customers hitting 500s.

tyler: I can own the smoke tests — will add `sample-apps/edge-smoke` that installs a local pack and runs `pnpm build` + a minimal curl to the built edge route in a node-based emulator. ETA EOD.

alex: follow-up: file an internal bug for "per-subpath types in exports cause TS/bundler mismatches" and add docs guidance for SDK authors: "do not add `types` under conditional exports; use top-level `types` until upstream support stabilizes."

jordan: sweet, thanks all. leaving notes:
- revert PR (mina)
- patch publish once green (release)
- smoke tests + tsc trace test (tyler)
- support + changelog notices (sam)
:thumbsup:
